changelog.summary: Join approved product requirements to exact-build QA, support content and measurement evidence for a Product release decision.

title: Approved Requirement to Release Readiness
description: Join approved product requirements to exact-build QA, support content and measurement evidence for a Product release decision.
setup_prompt: Use Approved Requirement to Release Readiness as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Crews, source permissions, exact subject, owner and action policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, typed handoffs, a real manual first case and separate approval for consequential actions. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection enables no write or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: One accepted requirement, product, build, flag revision and rollout owner; no inferred exposure or adoption.
Read current approved requirement, build and flag, independent QA gate, help content and versioned usage rule.
A passing QA gate is one input. Product go needs current help, measurement and rollout authority; a no-go names blockers.
Accountable source, decision and action owners
Authorized connections or equivalent current exports
Manual-only or reviewed event and schedule policy
